issue_context.title: Devices stay disabled after re-enabling integrations
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I tried to narrow down another issue by disabling my integrations one by one in the integrations UI. After that I turned all integrations on again and restarted home-assistant using the UI.

Now, while my integrations are enabled, all their devices and entities are still disabled and can't be manually enabled.
Entities can't be enabled because the devices they belong to are disabled and devices show "The device is disabled by Config entry." with no "Enable" button.

The only way I found to re-enable the devices is to remove and re-add the integration it belongs to. Disabling and re-enabling the integration again does not work.

This affects all integrations I use, which means it's probably not integration specific.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.12.8

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

review_comments: We set it to `UNDEFINED` so we know it is not requested to be changed. This "fix" would re-enable every device when updating it's data.

Ok, yeah I almost thought that's the wrong approach.

I guess there must be something wrong in `async_set_disabled_by` (https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/2021.12.9/homeassistant/config_entries.py#L987), but I can't really see what could go wrong there.
